Subject: Initial: SSO + provisioning details for Redwood onboarding

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We are ready to move forward with Redwood in our staging environment. Before the implementation call, our security team asked for the following details so we can provision access on our side:

- SAML metadata (entityID, ACS URL) and example NameID/identifier mapping expectations
- SCIM schema and which attributes Redwood consumes for users/groups (email, displayName, department, manager)
- Temporary service account credentials or a test integration profile for API-based SCIM calls
- IP ranges for allowlisting (staging and prod), and any hostnames used for callbacks/webhooks

I can attach what we have from our IdP once you confirm the exact attributes. We'd like to schedule the implementation kickoff next Wed (Mar 18) if that works for your team.

Director, IT Operations
ACME Health

Subject: Re: Initial: SSO + provisioning details for Redwood onboarding

Maria —

Great to hear you're ready. I'll loop in our Implementation and Security leads (Connor + Lauren) to coordinate the technical handoff. Quick answers while they join:

- We support SAML 2.0 (HTTP-POST binding) and expect the NameID to be email by default, but we can accept a persistent NameID if you prefer. Our ACS URL and SP entityID vary by environment; Connor will provide exact values for staging and prod.
- SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0 PATCH/PUT with the standard user schema. Typical attributes we consume: userName (email), name.familyName, name.givenName, displayName, active, emails, groups membership via group endpoint. We can map custom attributes if needed.
- For testing, we can provision a short-lived service account key that restricts operations to a dedicated staging org.
- IP allowlist: we publish explicit CIDR blocks for staging and prod; Connor will paste them into this thread.

Connor — can you drop the exact ACS/entityID URLs, the staging IP ranges, and attach our standard scim_schema_mapping.csv and saml_metadata.xml generator? Also adding Lauren for any security sign-off steps and timeline confirmation.

Proposed kickoff: Wed Mar 18, 10:00 AM ET (suggested). If that doesn't work, we have slots Mar 17 or Mar 19.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Subject: Re: Initial: SSO + provisioning details for Redwood onboarding

Hi Maria —

Thanks for the clear list. I've pasted the staging values below and attached the mapping files you'll find helpful. Long version is a short checklist and test plan so your IdP team can configure and we can validate during the kickoff:

Staging SP details (use these for initial IdP config):
- SP entityID: https://staging.redwood.ai/saml/metadata/acme-health
- ACS URL (POST): https://staging.redwood.ai/saml/acs/acme-health
- NameID: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress (we accept email by default)

Staging IP ranges (egress from Redwood to your APIs / webhooks):
- 35.201.64.0/20
- 34.103.128.0/17
(These are our staging NAT ranges; production ranges will be provided after contract signature.)

Service account for SCIM testing: we will create a scoped API key for the staging org that only allows POST/PATCH on /Users and GET on /Groups. We will send the key via the DocuSign-secured link in this thread before the kickoff.

SCIM / attribute guidance (attached file: scim_schema_mapping.csv):
- Required: userName -> emails[0].value, active -> active, name.givenName & name.familyName mapped to first/last
- Optional: department -> extension:department, manager -> extension:managerId (we can accept manager as an externalId)

Security/Org policy notes:
- We recommend configuring automatic group sync for role-based access rather than provisioning individual roles.
- If your IdP supports SCIM group pushes, choose a single "Redwood-Admins" group and a separate "Redwood-Users" group to simplify RBAC during onboarding.

Attachments (staging): saml_metadata.xml (generator), scim_schema_mapping.csv, redwood_onboarding_map.pdf (MAP + timeline).

Kickoff: confirmed for Wed Mar 18, 10:00 AM ET. Please send the IdP contact and preferred conferencing link. We'll include a short runbook and a 45-minute technical validation window.

Connor O'Brien
Implementation Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0222

(Attachment stubs: saml_metadata.xml [XML], scim_schema_mapping.csv [CSV], redwood_onboarding_map.pdf [PDF])

Connor / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. I've attached our IdP metadata and an export of our group structure for your mapping: acme_saml_metadata.xml and acme_group_export.csv. A few notes from our side:

- We currently assert email as NameID; we can switch to persistent id if Redwood prefers but email is easiest for now.
- We only sync manager as a custom attribute right now; we'll map it to extension:managerId per your suggestion.
- Staging org prefers test API keys delivered via a secure DocuSign link. Please create the key and share the link when ready.
- For allowlisting, our firewall team asked whether Redwood initiates the SCIM calls to our SCIM endpoint or if we should poll. We have a SCIM endpoint for incoming provisioning.

Proposed test scope for kickoff: create 5 test users (2 admins, 3 end users), validate sign-in + SSO, validate SCIM deprovisioning on user disable, and confirm webhook callback for audit events.

Attaching: acme_saml_metadata.xml (XML), acme_group_export.csv (CSV).

Maria

(Attachment stubs: acme_saml_metadata.xml [XML], acme_group_export.csv [CSV])
